shared_session_disclosure: Under Pre-Results Amendment 2, Track (b) rulings/rationales and Track (c) codebook answers q1..q4 were generated inside the same standalone session per model family (s1: gemini_carbon, s2: grok_4_7, s3: kimi_k3; plus extra sensitivity session gemini_hydrogen) on the withheld-origin 65-card packet. Accordingly, comparisons between Track (b) rulings and Track (c) induced formulas (pred_ch16, pred_ch2) measure within-session codebook-to-prose consistency rather than session-independent cross-validation, whereas independence holds across the three distinct model families and against the pre-committed benchmarkRows17 book rulings.

claim_scope.claim_tested: The one rule as printed in The Sovereign Mirror v57 (pp. 20 and 116) is enough to rule on a law it was not built from, in hands other than the author's.
